Vintage sharp rendering, rich micro-contrast, subtle warm highlights, clean 35mm color density, precise edge definition.

brick + overcast
Red brick and black window frames are already graphic. Soft grey sky keeps the patent from blowing out and the brick from turning orange.
The human part: the hand on the window edge. She's holding on, just a little. It's the most honest detail in the frame.
Prompt keys: worm's-eye, camera on the pavement, ~14mm ultrawide, high kick toward lens, glossy brown patent pointed pump, outsole to camera, white wide-leg trousers, brown tee, brick piers converging, overcast, Classic Chrome, film grain.
